text:
nora: Heads-up: I was about to schedule the monthly admin-entitlement prune for MON AM, but saw a KMS rotation happened last night and a vuln-triage ticket is still open. Should we gate the prune?
oncall-bot: SCHEDULE: privileged-prune job queued for 2026-04-06T09:00Z (job id prune-2026-04-06)
security-bot: KMS notice: key redwood-prod-svc rotated at 2026-04-05T23:45:12Z (version v5). Related ticket: https://issues.internal/SEC-9821
marcos: if prune removes roles while services are picking up new key versions we might produce 503s. recommend skip-on-rotation policy (no rotations in last 24h) + require last-authn > 48h to avoid active clients.
devin: agree. also add: write an audit event for each decision and include KMS-version, last-authn, and ticket id. we should be able to revert via automation (un-prune) if telemetry spikes.
nora: sounds good. quick check: `gcloud kms keys versions list --keyring=prod-kr --key=redwood-prod-svc --location=global` output showed v5 active, v4 disabled.
infra-bot: cloud: recent deploys: none in last 12h. svc account token errors: 4 occurrences between 2026-04-05T23:40Z and 2026-04-05T23:50Z (likely rotation gap).
devin: ok pause. nora pls update prune config: add rotation_gate_hours=24 and last_active_threshold_hours=48. Also add metric prune.audit_event_count and prune.rollback_triggered_count.
nora: will open PR with config + audit sink changes. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-configs/pull/789 — "prune: KMS rotation gating + last-active threshold + audit events"
marcos: add a checklist item for incident team to confirm SEC-9821 triage complete before enabling.
oncall-bot: ACTION: prune job paused until manual enable; will auto-resume after manual approval.
security-bot: REMINDER: if you need to run a one-off dry-run, use `prune-cli --dry-run --force-check-kms` and annotate ticket id.
devin: put the weekly manual review on calendars (security + infra + product-ops). nora can you schedule?
nora: scheduled invite for Tue 09:30 PT and added agenda: sample candidates, audit event schema, rollback playbook. I'll paste the post-run checklist in the PR once it's up.
marcos: thanks — good call catching rotation before doing the sweep. :pray:
